mod1.title: Module 1 — DocumentoIQ Fundamentals
mod1.objective: By the end of this module, the partner will be able to: Explain what DocumentoIQ is. Understand the problem it solves. Understand how the platform works at a high level. Correctly communicate the role of AI. Differentiate DocumentoIQ from other solutions. Identify initial commercial opportunities.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1 — Welcome to the Partner Program

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Understand the Partner's role and how they work with the DocumentoIQ team.

sections.title: What is a Partner?
sections.body: Partners are commercial allies who identify opportunities, present DocumentoIQ to potential clients, and manage the commercial relationship during the sales process.

sections.title: Our shared goal
sections.body: Help organizations that work with complex documents reduce operational times, improve accuracy, and increase efficiency through AI-powered document intelligence.

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Understand what DocumentoIQ is and how to explain it correctly.

sections.title: Recommended definition
sections.body: DocumentoIQ is an AI-powered document intelligence platform that helps professionals and organizations analyze, review, and extract relevant information from complex documents faster and more accurately. The platform assists users in document processes that typically require large amounts of time and manual review.

sections.title: The problem it solves
sections.body: Many organizations work daily with: contracts, deeds, powers of attorney, mortgages, files, financial documentation, and extensive legal documents. Manual review of these documents is often: slow, costly, repetitive, and prone to human error. DocumentoIQ helps optimize these processes through intelligent automation and document assistance.

benefits.title: Reduced operational time
benefits.body: Analyze large document volumes in minutes.

benefits.title: Better information access
benefits.body: Identify key information in extensive documents.

benefits.title: Scalability
benefits.body: Handle higher volumes without increasing operational load.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.3 — What DocumentoIQ is NOT

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Eliminate misconceptions about DocumentoIQ.

noNos.title: DocumentoIQ does NOT replace professionals
noNos.body: DocumentoIQ works as a support tool. Final validation always remains in the hands of the responsible professional.

noNos.title: DocumentoIQ does NOT make legal decisions
noNos.body: The platform identifies, organizes and presents information. Legal, financial or regulatory decisions remain the responsibility of experts.

noNos.title: DocumentoIQ does NOT replace notaries, lawyers or analysts
noNos.body: DocumentoIQ helps these professionals work more efficiently by reducing repetitive tasks and accelerating document processes.

noNos.title: DocumentoIQ is NOT just OCR
noNos.body: A traditional OCR converts images to text. DocumentoIQ also understands context, identifies relevant information, executes workflows, organizes results and facilitates document analysis.

lessons.keyMessage: DocumentoIQ does not seek to replace professional judgment. It seeks to enhance it.

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Understand the general platform workflow.

sections.title: What technologies are involved?
sections.body: DocumentoIQ combines: advanced OCR, artificial intelligence, document processing, specialized workflows and intelligent automation.

sections.title: Final result
sections.body: Users get information faster, with greater consistency and less operational effort, always maintaining control and professional validation.

steps.title: Document upload
steps.body: User uploads digital or scanned documents into the platform.

steps.title: Reading and digitization
steps.body: DocumentoIQ uses advanced OCR to interpret documents even from scans or images.

steps.title: AI analysis
steps.body: AI identifies relevant information based on document type and workflow.

steps.title: Workflow execution
steps.body: The platform processes information using specialized rules and flows for each use case. Examples: Power of attorney review, Notarial backgrounds, Banking files, Document validation.

steps.title: Structured results
steps.body: Information is presented in an organized way for review, validation and decision making.

questions.question: What is DocumentoIQ's main purpose?
options: Help analyze, review, and extract information from complex documents faster and more accurately.
Generate legal contracts without human intervention.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes DocumentoIQ?
options: It combines OCR, AI, and workflows for complex document processes.
It only works for notarial documents.

questions.question: What message should a Partner communicate?
options: It's a support tool that accelerates processes, keeping validation in the professional's hands.

result.approved: You passed. Review the main concepts before continuing.

mod2.title: Module 2 — AI Applied to Documents
mod2.objective: Understand how DocumentoIQ uses AI, explain the difference between OCR and document intelligence, communicate AI's role, and resolve frequent doubts.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.1 — How AI Works in DocumentoIQ

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Understand AI's role in the platform.

sections.title: AI as a document assistant
sections.body: DocumentoIQ uses AI to help users work with complex documents faster. AI can identify relevant information, organize data, and facilitate review processes.

lessons.keyMessage: DocumentoIQ uses AI to accelerate document work, not to replace professional judgment.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.2 — OCR vs Document Intelligence

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Understand why DocumentoIQ goes beyond traditional OCR.

sections.title: What is OCR?
sections.body: OCR = Optical Character Recognition. Converts images to text.

sections.title: OCR limitations
sections.body: Reads text but doesn't understand context, meaning, or document structure.

lessons.keyMessage: OCR digitizes documents. DocumentoIQ helps understand them.

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Prepare the partner to answer frequent questions.

myths.r: DocumentoIQ is a support tool. Final validation is with the professional.
AI accelerates processes, but results require human validation.
DocumentoIQ does not make legal or financial decisions.
DocumentoIQ was designed for complex documents.
AI is already transforming document processes with measurable improvements.

questions.question: Difference between OCR and DocumentoIQ?
options: DocumentoIQ combines OCR and AI to identify, understand context, and organize results.

questions.question: What is AI's role in DocumentoIQ?
options: Assist in identifying, organizing, and analyzing information.

questions.question: How to respond if a prospect says AI will replace professionals?
options: Explain it's a support tool and final validation is professional.

result.approved: You passed. Review OCR and professional validation.

mod3.title: Module 3 — Security and Confidentiality
mod3.objective: Explain how DocumentoIQ protects information, answer security and privacy questions, and know when to escalate technical queries.

lessons.title: Lesson 3.1 — Security by Design

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Understand why security is fundamental.

sections.title: Importance
sections.body: DocumentoIQ works with legal, financial, and personal data. Security is an essential part of the design.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: The platform incorporates protection mechanisms, access control, and best practices.

lessons.keyMessage: DocumentoIQ was designed for organizations handling sensitive information.

lessons.title: Lesson 3.2 — Information Protection

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Understand how information is protected.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.body: Processed information is confidential and managed securely.

sections.title: Access control
sections.body: Only authorized users access according to roles and permissions.

sections.title: Traceability
sections.body: The platform logs activity for auditing.

lessons.keyMessage: Information belongs to the client and remains under their control.

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Prepare the partner to answer common questions.

faqs.r: Yes. Designed to handle sensitive information securely.
Only users authorized by the organization.

faqs.q: Are documents used to train public AI?
faqs.r: No. They are not shared with third parties.

faqs.q: Is information shared with third parties?
Does it work with sensitive documents?
faqs.r: Yes, designed for industries with critical documents.

lessons.title: Lesson 3.4 — How to Talk About Security

sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Convey confidence without unnecessary technical details.

doItems: Confidentiality: information belongs to the client.
Supervision: final validation with the user.

options: No. They are not used for public models or shared.

mod5.title: Module 5 — How to Sell DocumentoIQ
mod5.objective: Identify opportunities, conduct discovery calls, present DocumentoIQ strategically, handle objections, and know when to escalate.

sections.title: Positive signals
sections.body: "We review hundreds of documents a month", "Our processes are manual", "Review consumes too much time".

sections.title: Low priority signals
sections.body: "We process few documents", "We are already automated".

sections.title: What NOT to do
sections.body: Don't start talking about AI or features.

sections.title: Key questions
sections.body: How many documents do you process? How much time do you invest? What processes are manual? Where do errors occur?

sections.title: Structure
sections.body: 1. Talk about the problem. 2. Connect with impact. 3. Present DocumentoIQ. 4. Explain benefits. 5. Show use cases.

objections.r: It's a support tool. Validation is with the professional.
DocumentoIQ goes beyond: identifies, organizes, and facilitates.
Time reduction and ability to scale.

questions.question: In a first meeting, what's the first goal?
options: Understand current processes and identify challenges.

questions.question: A bank reviews files manually. Best response?
options: Deep dive into the process and connect with benefits.
